title: Dynamic Linking and Shared Libraries
description: Trace an undefined symbol from the first reference to the shared library that answers it: the lookup scope, .dynsym, versioning, TLS blocks and loading at run time.
author: Underlayer
completion_criteria: Read all 10 concepts, reproduce the 85 measured checks in courses/dyn/assets/samples/crosscheck.py, and run courses/dyn/assets/samples/dynscope.py tour

concepts.title: The Global Scope
concepts.description: The ordered list every undefined symbol is answered from, and how the loader builds it.

concepts.title: Interposition
concepts.description: The executable's definition wins, including inside libraries that did nothing unusual.

concepts.title: Breadth-First, and Why It Matters
concepts.description: Level-by-level or branch-by-branch, measured from the loader's own load order.

concepts.title: Building a Library
concepts.description: What ends up in .dynsym, and the four commands that decide it.

concepts.title: Hiding Things, and the Trap
concepts.description: -fvisibility=hidden, version scripts, and the flag that breaks every caller.

concepts.title: One Instruction Called -Bsymbolic
concepts.description: What it binds, what it does not, and the precise thing its name hides.

concepts.title: dlopen, dlsym, and the Mode Bits
concepts.description: Loading a library at run time, and why RTLD_LOCAL is 0.

concepts.title: Lazy, Eager, and What Actually Differs
concepts.description: One binding either way, and the .got.plt section that disappears.

concepts.title: Where the Thread Blocks Come From
concepts.description: The loader allocating storage the linker could not, completing the TLS story.

concepts.title: Rebuilding the Scope Yourself
concepts.description: Read DT_NEEDED, walk it breadth-first, resolve a symbol, and check against the real loader.
